## Problem and change

Explain the concrete problem, resulting behavior, and related issue (if any).

## Validation

List checks actually run and their results. For UI/native changes, include OS/architecture and screenshots or manual steps. State any checks you could not run.

## Compatibility and risk

Describe data-format changes, migrations, security implications, and remaining limitations. Use "none" when appropriate.

- [ ] I read CONTRIBUTING.md and kept this change focused.
- [ ] I included a regression test for a behavior fix, or explained why one is not applicable.
- [ ] I updated affected documentation and third-party notices if needed.
- [ ] I checked that fixtures/logs contain no personal, company, or secret data.
